relationships.subject: Nrf2
relationships.evidence_quote: By upregulating or overexpressing Nrf2, we confirmed its ability to inhibit TRPV4 and thereby attenuate RIH-associated mechanical allodynia, M1 polarization, and neuroinflammation.

relationships.subject: TRPV4
relationships.evidence_quote: demonstrating an apparent microglial M1 polarization and increased TRPV4 channel expression

relationships.subject: dexmedetomidine
relationships.evidence_quote: dexmedetomidine demonstrated therapeutic potential by positively modulating the Nrf2-TRPV4 nexus, attenuating mechanical allodynia, and reducing microglial inflammation.

key_findings: Remifentanil downregulates spinal microglial Nrf2/HO-1 and increases TRPV4 and M1 polarization; Nrf2 upregulation inhibits TRPV4 and attenuates RIH.
Dexmedetomidine modulates the Nrf2-TRPV4 axis and reduces RIH.
